home.title: Werewolf
home.subtitle: Can you find the wolf among us?
home.step1Desc: Create or join a room with 6-16 players
home.step2Desc: Each player receives a secret role
home.step3Desc: Werewolves hunt at night, villagers vote by day
home.demoRoomDesc: Play with bots to test all features
home.nameRequired: Please enter your name (at least 2 characters)
home.clickRoleToLearn: Click a role to learn more
home.gameFlowStep1Desc: Host creates a room, selects roles and settings. Players join with a room code.
home.gameFlowStep2Desc: Werewolves choose a victim. Special roles (Seer, Doctor, Witch...) use their abilities.
home.gameFlowStep3Desc: Results are announced — who was killed, who was saved.
home.gameFlowStep4Desc: All players discuss and debate. Gunner can shoot. Suspects are nominated.
home.gameFlowStep5Desc: Players vote to eliminate a suspect. Majority needed — ties mean no elimination.
home.gameFlowStep6Desc: Village wins when all wolves are dead. Wolves win when they equal or outnumber villagers. Solo roles have their own win conditions.

game.introStory: Night descends upon a peaceful village. But hidden among the villagers are cunning werewolves, waiting for darkness to strike. Can you uncover the wolves before it's too late?
game.introLine1: In a small village deep in the forest, life was once very peaceful...
game.introLine2: Everyone knew each other, worked together, and shared warm evenings.
game.introLine3: But then one moonlit night, howls echoed from the dark forest.
game.introLine4: The next morning, a villager was missing. The truth began to emerge...
game.introLine5: Werewolves had infiltrated the village. By day they posed as villagers, but when night fell, their true nature awakened.
game.introLine6: Open your eyes, observe carefully… and let the game begin. 🐺
game.witchHealDesc: Use your heal potion to save the werewolves' target tonight. One-time use.
game.witchAttackedInfo: was attacked by werewolves! Use your heal potion to save them.
game.witchNoAttack: No one was attacked by werewolves tonight.
game.deadCantChat: Dead players can only use ghost chat 👻
game.nightSilence: The village is silent at night...

villager.name: Villager
villager.desc: A regular villager with no special abilities. Use your wits to find the werewolves!

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.desc: Each night, protect one player from being killed

gunner.name: Gunner
gunner.desc: Has 2 bullets to shoot any player during the day

seer.name: Seer
seer.desc: Each night, view one player's exact role

auraSeer.name: Aura Seer
auraSeer.desc: Each night, view one player's alignment (Good/Evil/Unknown)

medium.name: Medium
medium.desc: Talk to dead players each night. Resurrect one player per game

witch.name: Witch
witch.desc: Has 1 heal potion (only when target is attacked) and 1 kill potion

avenger.name: Avenger
avenger.desc: Choose a player who will die if you are killed

beastHunter.name: Beast Hunter
beastHunter.desc: Place a trap. If wolf bites trapped player, weakest wolf dies

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.desc: Normal villager until bitten by werewolf, then becomes a werewolf

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: Protect one player each night. Cannot protect the same player two nights in a row. If target is attacked, Bodyguard dies instead

priest.name: Priest
priest.desc: Has holy water. If killed by werewolves, the attacking wolf also dies

elder.name: Elder
elder.desc: Survives the first werewolf attack. Dies normally on the second attack

baker.name: Baker
baker.desc: The village baker. Everyone knows who the Baker is. If Baker dies, village loses morale

drunk.name: Drunk
drunk.desc: Doesn't know their real role until night 3. Acts as Villager until then

mayor.name: Mayor
mayor.desc: Can reveal during the day to gain double voting power, but becomes a target

pacifist.name: Pacifist
pacifist.desc: A peaceful villager. If voted out, reveals all players who voted for them

sleepwalker.name: Sleepwalker
sleepwalker.desc: Wanders at night. Has a chance to accidentally visit a player, learning if they acted that night

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.desc: Lives alone. Cannot be targeted by werewolves on the first night

apprenticeSeer.name: Apprentice Seer
apprenticeSeer.desc: A regular villager until the Seer dies, then inherits the Seer's power

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.desc: Each night, vote with other wolves to kill one player

werewolfShaman.name: Werewolf Shaman
werewolfShaman.desc: During the day, curse a player to appear Evil to Seers that night

alphaWerewolf.name: Alpha Werewolf
alphaWerewolf.desc: A werewolf with double voting power in the night kill vote

werewolfSeer.name: Werewolf Seer
werewolfSeer.desc: View one player's role at night — all wolves see the result

nightmareWolf.name: Nightmare Wolf
nightmareWolf.desc: Choose a player to silence. That player cannot use their night ability this night

shadowWolf.name: Shadow Wolf
shadowWolf.desc: Appears as Unknown to Seers. Hides among the villagers more easily

bloodMoonWolf.name: Blood Moon Wolf
bloodMoonWolf.desc: Every 3rd night, the wolf kill cannot be saved by Doctor or Witch

howlerWolf.name: Howler Wolf
howlerWolf.desc: When a wolf dies, Howler lets out a cry that reveals one random village role

loneWolf.name: Lone Wolf
loneWolf.desc: A werewolf who also wins solo if they are the last wolf alive. Has own kill target

venomWolf.name: Venom Wolf
venomWolf.desc: Once per game, poison a player. That player dies the following night regardless

headhunter.name: Headhunter
headhunter.desc: Get your target voted out to win. If target dies otherwise, join Village

fool.name: Fool
fool.desc: Win by getting yourself voted out during the day

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.desc: Place a bomb at night, explodes next night. Immune to werewolf kills

serialKiller.name: Serial Killer
serialKiller.desc: Kill one player each night independently. Win when you are the last one standing

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.desc: On the first night, link two players as lovers. If one dies, the other dies too. Lovers win together if they are the last 2 alive

arsonist.name: Arsonist
arsonist.desc: Douse a player in gasoline each night. Ignite to kill all doused players at once. Win when all others are dead

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.desc: Has 2 bulletproof vests. Win by simply surviving to the end of the game

amnesiac.name: Amnesiac
amnesiac.desc: Doesn't remember their role. Choose a dead player to copy their role and team

doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
doppelganger.desc: Choose a player on night 1. When that player dies, you become their role

jester.name: Jester
jester.desc: Win by getting yourself voted out. When voted out, one player who voted for you dies

vigilante.name: Vigilante
vigilante.desc: Has 1 bullet to shoot a suspect at night. Be careful — you might kill an innocent villager!

spy.name: Spy
spy.desc: Each night, learn which player the werewolves targeted. Information is power!

jailer.name: Jailer
jailer.desc: Lock a player in jail each night. They cannot be killed or use abilities. Can't jail the same person twice in a row

graveRobber.name: Grave Robber
graveRobber.desc: Each night, peek at a dead player's grave to learn their role. Useful for deduction!

infectorWolf.name: Infector Wolf
infectorWolf.desc: Once per game, infect a player instead of killing. Infected appear Evil to seers for 2 nights

stalkerWolf.name: Stalker Wolf
stalkerWolf.desc: Each night, stalk a player to learn who they visited. Share intel with your pack

cursedWolf.name: Cursed Wolf
cursedWolf.desc: If voted out during the day, one random player who voted for you also dies

pirate.name: Pirate
pirate.desc: Duel a player each night — they die unless protected. Win after 2 successful duels

plagueDoctor.name: Plague Doctor
plagueDoctor.desc: Spread plague each night. When you die, all plagued players die with you. Win if 3+ are plagued when you die

corruptor.name: Corruptor
corruptor.desc: Corrupt a player each night — they permanently appear Evil to seers. Win when 3 players are corrupted

death.vote: {player} was voted out by the village
death.avenger: {player} was killed by the Avenger's revenge
death.bomb: {player} was killed by the Bomber's explosion
death.trap: {player} was killed by Beast Hunter's trap
death.serialKiller: {player} was murdered by the Serial Killer
death.venom: {player} died from the Venom Wolf's poison
death.pirate: {player} was killed in a pirate duel
death.cursedWolfRevenge: {player} was cursed and died after voting
